policy: V18 separates mathematical distribution capacity from exact beneficiary planning and human/multisig authorization. Distribution plan bytes fix source, currency, beneficiary destinations, amounts and idempotency keys before approval; authorization remains non-executing and stale when plan/capacity/policy context changes.

additions.authority_note: Exact same-currency single-batch beneficiary plan bound to one DistributionCapacityReplay and LiquidityReplay. Source account, every destination, amount and payment idempotency key are content-addressed before authorization. Plan has no authorization or execution authority.

Human-committee or multisig exact-batch distribution decision binding current Plan, CapacityReplay, LiquidityReplay, beneficiary set, requirement registry and approver policy. AI authority is NONE. Execution is a separate MetaPay batch handoff.
